# SOTA Advisory

> Fractional CTO and AI strategy advisory for growth-stage startups. Founded by Aanchal Jain (ex-Block, Slack, Quantcast, Razer). Interim CTO leadership, AI strategy, AI cost reduction, and technical due diligence.

## Positioning

Twenty years turning technical strategy into working software. The person who designs the architecture is the person who ships it, so nothing gets lost in the handoff. Fractional CTO · Strategy that ships.

## Signature facts

- Cut AI spend by 85% at Double Blind Bio in weeks as Interim CTO (2026)
- 10x developer velocity improvement via spec-driven development
- Patent on the AI infrastructure architecture that came out of the Double Blind Bio engagement
- 20+ years of engineering leadership
- 4 patents total, spanning mobile software and AI infrastructure
- $100M+ ARR products managed across 4 revenue lines at Block
- 40% lift in production-ready AI code generation at Block
- 50% operational cost reduction at Quantcast
- 3 Android phones shipped at Razer
- Led product for Slack Connect (security and compliance included)

## Approach

AI-first, observability before you build. Three steps:
1. Instrument: metrics, evals, dashboards, per-feature token accounting before a single production prompt goes live
2. Prioritize: AI bets ranked by ROI, gross-margin impact, and evidence
3. Ship & Contain: model routing, caching, guardrails, and budget alerts turn AI from experimental burn into a predictable, high-margin cost line
